class.name: OcgGpGtrsf
class.brief_description: Defines a non-persistent transformation in 3D space. This transformation is a general transformation. It can be a gp_Trsf, an affinity, or you can define your own transformation giving the matrix of transformation.
class.description: ! Defines a non-persistent transformation in 3D space. ! This transformation is a general transformation. ! It can be a gp_Trsf, an affinity, or you can define ! your own transformation giving the matrix of transformation. ! ! With a gp_GTrsf you can transform only a triplet of coordinates gp_XYZ. ! It is not possible to transform other geometric objects ! because these transformations can change the nature of non-elementary geometric objects. ! The transformation gp_GTrsf can be represented as follow: ! @code ! V1 V2 V3 T XYZ XYZ ! | a11 a12 a13 a14 | | x | | x'| ! | a21 a22 a23 a24 | | y | | y'| ! | a31 a32 a33 a34 | | z | = | z'| ! | 0 0 0 1 | | 1 | | 1 | ! @endcode ! where {V1, V2, V3} define the vectorial part of the ! transformation and T defines the translation part of the transformation. ! Warning ! A gp_GTrsf transformation is only applicable to coordinates. ! Be careful if you apply such a transformation to all points of a geometric object, ! as this can change the nature of the object and thus render it incoherent! ! Typically, a circle is transformed into an ellipse by an affinity transformation. ! To avoid modifying the nature of an object, use a gp_Trsf transformation instead, ! as objects of this class respect the nature of geometric objects.

method.name: default
method.description: Returns the Identity transformation.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Converts the gp_Trsf transformation theT into a general transformation, i.e. Returns a GTrsf with the same matrix of coefficients as the Trsf theT.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Creates a transformation based on the matrix theM and the vector theV where theM defines the vectorial part of the transformation, and V the translation part, or

method.name: SetAffinity_1
method.description: Changes this transformation into an affinity of ratio theRatio with respect to the axis theA1. Note: an affinity is a point-by-point transformation that transforms any point P into a point P' such that if H is the orthogonal projection of P on the axis theA1 or the plane A2, the vectors HP and HP' satisfy: HP' = theRatio * HP.

method.name: SetAffinity_2
method.description: Changes this transformation into an affinity of ratio theRatio with respect to the plane defined by the origin, the "X Direction" and the "Y Direction" of coordinate system theA2. Note: an affinity is a point-by-point transformation that transforms any point P into a point P' such that if H is the orthogonal projection of P on the axis A1 or the plane theA2, the vectors HP and HP' satisfy: HP' = theRatio * HP.

method.name: SetValue
method.description: Replaces the coefficient (theRow, theCol) of the matrix representing this transformation by theValue. Raises OutOfRange if theRow < 1 or theRow > 3 or theCol < 1 or theCol > 4

method.name: SetVectorialPart
method.description: Replaces the vectorial part of this transformation by theMatrix.

method.name: SetTranslationPart
method.description: Replaces the translation part of this transformation by the coordinates of the number triple theCoord.

method.name: SetTrsf
method.description: Assigns the vectorial and translation parts of theT to this transformation.

method.name: IsSingular
method.description: Returns true if this transformation is singular (and therefore, cannot be inverted). Note: The Gauss LU decomposition is used to invert the transformation matrix. Consequently, the transformation is considered as singular if the largest pivot found is less than or equal to gp::Resolution(). Warning If this transformation is singular, it cannot be inverted.

method.name: Form
method.description: Returns the nature of the transformation. It can be an identity transformation, a rotation, a translation, a mirror transformation (relative to a point, an axis or a plane), a scaling transformation, a compound transformation or some other type of transformation.

method.name: SetForm
method.description: verify and set the shape of the GTrsf Other or CompoundTrsf Ex :

method.name: TranslationPart
method.description: Returns the translation part of the GTrsf.

method.name: VectorialPart
method.description: Computes the vectorial part of the GTrsf. The returned Matrix is a 3*3 matrix.

method.name: Value
method.description: Returns the coefficients of the global matrix of transformation. Raises OutOfRange if theRow < 1 or theRow > 3 or theCol < 1 or theCol > 4

method.name: Inverted
method.description: Computes the reverse transformation. Raises an exception if the matrix of the transformation is not inversible.

method.name: Multiplied
method.description: Computes the transformation composed from theT and <me>. In a C++ implementation you can also write Tcomposed = <me> * theT. Example :

method.name: Multiply
method.description: Computes the transformation composed with <me> and theT. <me> = <me> * theT

method.name: PreMultiply
method.description: Computes the product of the transformation theT and this transformation and assigns the result to this transformation. this = theT * this

method.name: Powered
method.description: Computes: - the product of this transformation multiplied by itself theN times, if theN is positive, or - the product of the inverse of this transformation multiplied by itself |theN| times, if theN is negative. If theN equals zero, the result is equal to the Identity transformation. I.e.: <me> * <me> * .......* <me>, theN time. if theN =0 <me> = Identity if theN < 0 <me> = <me>.Inverse() *...........* <me>.Inverse().

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
